title: About Us
content: Power Tools Plug is a Nairobi-based supplier of power tools, generators and industrial equipment. Showroom: Magomano House, 1st Floor, Room 10D, Tom Mboya Street, Nairobi. Open Mon-Sat 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM. Tel +254 708 777192, info@powertoolsplugke.co.ke. We supply products from a range of manufacturers and established suppliers; the manufacturer or brand shown on each product page reflects the product being offered.

title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
content: We deliver countrywide via trusted couriers and rider services. Delivery is KES 300 within Nairobi and KES 500 to the rest of Kenya; heavy or oversized items are quoted by the courier based on weight and size. Order before 5:00 PM for same-day Nairobi dispatch. Typical delivery times: Nairobi same or next day; major towns 1-3 business days; remote areas 2-5 business days. Tracking details are shared by SMS/WhatsApp after dispatch. Contact +254 708 777192 for any delays.

title: Returns & Refund Policy
content: You may return an unused item in its original packaging within 7 days of delivery. Faulty or wrongly-supplied items are replaced or fully refunded at our cost. To start a return, call +254 708 777192 or email info@powertoolsplugke.co.ke with your order number. Approved refunds are processed to the original M-Pesa/payment method within 3-5 business days. Return shipping for change-of-mind is paid by the buyer; for faulty items it is paid by us. Some hygiene/consumable items are non-returnable once opened.

title: Privacy Policy
content: We collect your name, phone, email and delivery address solely to process and deliver orders and to provide support. We do not sell your data. Payment is handled by M-Pesa and our payment providers; we do not store card details. You may request access to or deletion of your data by emailing info@powertoolsplugke.co.ke. This policy is specific to Power Tools Plug Kenya.

title: Terms & Conditions
content: By ordering from Power Tools Plug you agree to these terms. Prices are in Kenyan Shillings (KES) and include applicable taxes unless stated. Payment methods: M-Pesa and Pay on Delivery (where available). Warranty terms follow each manufacturer's policy where applicable. Disputes are governed by the laws of Kenya. Contact: Magomano House, Tom Mboya Street, Nairobi; +254 708 777192.

title: FAQs
content:
What products do you sell? We supply power tools, solar and power equipment, generators, water pumps, hardware and accessories from a range of manufacturers and suppliers. The brand and model of each item are shown on its product page.

Do you deliver countrywide? Yes. Delivery is KES 300 within Nairobi and KES 500 to the rest of Kenya, with Nairobi same/next day, major towns 1-3 business days and remote areas 2-5 business days.

What payments do you accept? M-Pesa and Pay on Delivery.

Do products have a warranty? Manufacturer warranty applies where available; details are shown on the product page.
